statusDetail: Cloudflare Managed Challenge returned HTTP 403 (cf-mitigated: challenge) and remained on “Performing security verification” after a 15-second browser retry, preventing access to the target site UI.

page.notes: The target application was not reached. Every browser and raw HTTP attempt received Cloudflare challenge content.

paths.description: Homepage recon intended to identify the site architecture, navigation, primary journeys, and representative page archetypes. It was blocked by a Cloudflare Managed Challenge. No deeper routes were selected because links, sitemap content, and application surfaces were inaccessible.
